# omggif

Vendored from https://github.com/deanm/omggif at commit
`0ec9069a525ec66223eadda3d62059d3685fd3b0`.

`omggif.js` includes the MIT license and copyright notice. It provides GIF
LZW decoding and encoding; `gif-media.js` provides playback, compositing,
frame disposal, and export palette conversion.

Run `npm run dev` and open `/tests/gif-media.html` for the browser regression
checks (timing, transparency, disposal, playback, seeking, and export).
